name: Default
note: The wallpaper through wallust's kmeans method with a 20% saturation boost: the bar, menus, Flow, borders, stack tabs, prompt and Windows accent take their colours from it, in the same places as always. Windows Terminal's sixteen colours keep fixed hues (red, green, yellow, blue, purple, cyan, each in a normal and a bright shade), mixed 15% with the wallpaper's Text colour -- distinct and readable on every wallpaper, still tinted by it. Ships with the repo and can't be edited -- the editor saves changes as a new profile. The Default before 2026-09-28 is config\palettes\archive\classic-default.json.
